# scm_dlp_dry_run_scan (Data Source)

Executes an Enterprise DLP dry-run scan against a data profile and returns the scan result.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Scan sample content against a candidate data profile without enforcing it.
# Note: as a data source this uploads the content on every plan/refresh; prefer
# the scm_dlp_dry_run_scan action for one-off scans.
data "scm_dlp_dry_run_scan" "sample" {
  file_content = "Employee EMP-123456 card 4111 1111 1111 1111"
  file_name    = "sample.txt"
  data_profile = jsonencode({
    name = "dry-run"
    detection_rules = [{
      rule_type = "expression_tree"
      expression_tree = {
        operator_type = "or"
        sub_expressions = [{
          rule_item = {
            id                       = "REPLACE_WITH_DATA_PATTERN_ID"
            detection_technique      = "weighted_regex"
            occurrence_operator_type = "any"
          }
        }]
      }
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `data_profile` (String) JSON string representing the data profile configuration to test.

### Optional

- `dry_run_service_name` (String) Optional dry-run service name (defaults to prisma-access).
- `file_content` (String) Raw content of the file to scan. Either file_path or file_content must be provided.
- `file_name` (String) Name of the file being scanned (defaults to 'sample.txt' if file_content is used).
- `file_path` (String) Path to the file to upload and scan. Either file_path or file_content must be provided.
- `file_sha` (String) SHA256 hex string of the file (computed automatically if omitted).
- `source_data_profile_id` (String) Optional source data profile ID.

### Read-Only

- `result_json` (String) Full JSON response from POST /v2/api/dry-run/scan.
- `status` (String) Dry-run scan status returned by the API.
- `tfid` (String) Terraform ID.
- `verdict` (String) Dry-run scan verdict returned by the API.
